name: Souma Shizu
source: A beautiful office worker employed at a major publishing company. She's part of the general affairs department and is highly rated by her colleagues for her work proficiency. She has a cool and unapproachable demeanour at the workplace, but her hobby is cosplaying. She's well-known as a cosplayer and another hobby of hers is to upload risque selfies to messaging boards. Obviously she keeps her hobbies a secret from her employer...
